item.title: Claude Daily Digest — Tuesday, Sep 2, 2026
item.description:
🆕 What's New

Claude Code v2.1.258 — Bug fixes and stability improvements.

Anthropic — "Developing Enterprise Frontier Safeguards" — New announcement on enterprise safety tooling for frontier model deployments.

📄 Docs Changes

Anthropic SDK beta graduation announced August 27 — the SDK is now stable. Update any beta pins in your dependencies.

💡 Tip of the Day

Use CLAUDE.md to set persistent context. Place a CLAUDE.md file at your repo root with project-specific instructions, coding conventions, and context. Claude Code reads it automatically at the start of every session — no need to re-explain your stack or preferences each time.

👀 Have You Seen? — Auto Mode

Auto mode in Claude Code lets Claude execute multi-step tasks without asking for approval at each step. Great for well-scoped tasks (refactors, test generation, documentation), but scope it carefully — Claude operates with the permissions of your current shell session. Always review irreversible operations before enabling auto mode on production codebases.
